errNumericDraft.message: Enter a decimal number using steps of 0.01, or a whole number for token limits and batch counts. Leave the token limit blank for automatic.

extDescription.message: Bilingual or replacement page translation using any OpenAI-compatible API.

cmdToggleMode.message: Switch between bilingual and replace mode

cacheHint.message: Translations are cached locally to avoid re-sending identical text. Clearing frees storage and forces fresh translations.

siteRulesHint.message: Per-site overrides. Auto-translate applies on load; blacklisted sites are never translated.

siteRulesEmpty.message: No site rules yet. Toggle “Auto-translate this site” in the popup, or add one here.

optionsSubtitle.message: Connect an API and choose translation defaults.

apiBaseHint.message: Both connection routes use the OpenAI V1 protocol.

apiKeyDirectHint.message: Required for a direct API connection.

apiKeyProxyHint.message: Optional when the proxy manages upstream credentials.

connectionModeDirectHint.message: The extension sends requests directly to your API. An API key is required.

connectionModeProxyHint.message: Connect to your own OpenAI-compatible proxy. Set its API base URL and provide an API key if it requires one.

customHeadersHint.message: Optional headers sent with every API request. They stay on this device. API key Authorization takes precedence.

customHeadersEmpty.message: No custom headers yet. Click “Add header” to create one.

customHeadersInvalid.message: Please check header names and values. Names must be unique and filled when a value is set.

maxConcurrentHint.message: Default 3. Higher values finish long pages faster but may trigger API rate limits or timeouts.

batchSizeHint.message: Default 6. Smaller batches return faster; larger batches save API calls but increase the risk of malformed JSON responses.

presetLocalApiHint.message: Uses your local server. Base URL should end with /v1. API key is usually optional.

presetDeepSeekHint.message: Direct DeepSeek API. Requires an API key.

presetOpenAIHint.message: OpenAI or any compatible /v1 endpoint. Requires an API key.

presetOllamaHint.message: Local Ollama OpenAI-compatible API. Key usually optional.

presetCustomHint.message: Enter any OpenAI-compatible base URL manually.

connV1Fixed.message: Updated URL to include /v1. Test again.

connConfigRequired.message: Add an API base URL and key.

connPermissionRequired.message: Browser permission for this API host was denied.

connModelNotFound.message: Model not found or endpoint path is wrong.

connMalformed.message: Got a response, but it was not usable.

connMissingV1.message: This looks like a server root. Add /v1 to the API base URL.

connNetworkError.message: Could not reach the API. Check the URL and that the server is running.

errPermissionRequired.message: Browser permission for this API host was denied.

errModelNotFound.message: Model not found or endpoint path is wrong.

errMalformed.message: Got a response, but it was not usable.

errPageRestricted.message: This page type cannot be translated (browser-restricted).

errPageUnsupported.message: This page is not available for translation.

errActionOpenSetup.message: Open setup to connect an API.

errActionGrantPermission.message: Allow access to the API host, then retry.

errActionUseHttps.message: Switch the API base to HTTPS.

errActionCheckKey.message: Check your API key in Options.

errActionCheckModel.message: Check the model name and /v1 path.

errActionWaitRetry.message: Wait a moment, then retry from the popup.

errActionFixV1.message: Add /v1 to the API base URL.

statusSiteDisabled.message: This site is disabled in TapTranslate

onboardingSubtitle.message: Three short steps to your first bilingual page.

onboardStep1Hint.message: Direct APIs and custom proxies use the same OpenAI-compatible protocol. Page text is sent only to the endpoint you configure.

onboardPathServerDesc.message: Uses your local server. Base URL should end with /v1. API key is usually optional.

onboardPathDirectDesc.message: Text goes to your configured cloud or self-hosted model. Requires an API key.

onboardPathLaterDesc.message: Browse the options later. Translation stays disabled until you connect.

onboardStep2Hint.message: Fill in the endpoint, then run a tiny test translation.

onboardPrivacy1.message: Visible page text you translate is sent to the API base above.

onboardPrivacy2.message: Your API key stays in this browser. Extension storage is not encrypted.

onboardPrivacy3.message: TapTranslate does not operate a translation cloud of its own.

rememberApiKey.message: Remember API key on this device

rememberApiKeyHint.message: Uncheck to keep the key only for this browser session.

sectionReadingHint.message: Choose interface and translation defaults for new pages. Site rules can override translation defaults.

sectionDataHint.message: Translated text goes only to your configured API. API keys and custom headers stay on this device; non-secret preferences may sync with your browser account.

advancedReadingHint.message: Leave defaults unless you hit rate limits or timeouts.

siteRulesHintCards.message: Use one exact hostname per rule. Auto-translate asks for site access when you save; never translate takes precedence.

confirmClearCache.message: Clear all cached translations on this device?

connectionNotConfiguredHint.message: Add your API details, then test and save the connection before translating.

uiLocaleHint.message: This changes extension pages and in-page controls. The browser controls the extension name shown in its own UI.

targetLanguageHint.message: This is the language translated page text will use; it does not change the extension interface.

translationModeHint.message: Bilingual keeps the original and adds a translation. Replace hides the original until you restore it.

siteHostHint.message: Use one exact hostname, such as example.com. Paths, ports, and wildcards are not supported.

errApiBaseInvalid.message: Enter a valid API base URL.

errSiteHostRequired.message: Enter a hostname for every site rule.

errSiteHostInvalid.message: Use an exact hostname without a path, port, or wildcard.

errSiteHostDuplicate.message: Each site rule needs a different hostname.

errSchedulingRange.message: Enter a whole number from $1 to $2.

sitePermissionDenied.message: Site access was not granted, so auto-translate was not enabled.

privacyTextDestination.message: Page text is sent to your configured translation API. Optional Gist backups send encrypted cache and settings to GitHub.

privacySecretsLocal.message: API keys and custom headers are kept on this device and excluded from browser sync. File exports include them; Gist backups encrypt them before upload.

privacyNoCloud.message: TapTranslate does not operate a translation cloud of its own.

importPreviewSummary.message: Only the listed values will change. Private values that are not listed stay on this device.

confirmImportOverwrite.message: Import the listed settings? Existing private values that are absent from the file will stay unchanged.

sitePolicyPopupHint.message: Auto-translate needs permission for this site.

presetMiniMaxHint.message: Direct MiniMax OpenAI-compatible API. Uses MiniMax-M3 by default and requires an API key.

presetSiliconFlowHint.message: Direct SiliconFlow OpenAI-compatible API. Uses DeepSeek-V4-Flash by default and requires an API key.

servicesHint.message: Add providers and configure each model independently. Select a model, then use it as the translation default.

modelParametersHint.message: Each model keeps its own parameters. Availability depends on your API.

temperatureHint.message: Lower values make translations more consistent.

maxTokensHint.message: Leave empty to estimate the budget for each batch.

translationInstructionsPlaceholder.message: Use terminology appropriate for academic papers…

translationInstructionsHint.message: Appended to the translation prompt; the JSON output format is kept.

addProviderHint.message: Choose a preset or add any OpenAI-compatible API.

presetArkAgentPlanHint.message: OpenAI-compatible Agent Plan API, using ark-code-latest by default. Requires a dedicated Agent Plan API key, not a standard Ark API key.

thinkingCustomHelp.message: Enter request JSON for each action. Use null for an unsupported action and {} to send no fields. Top-level null values remove fields. Custom automatic mode sends no thinking controls; set effort inside these JSON objects. Do not put credentials here: mappings are included in settings exports.

thinkingJsonInvalid.message: Use a JSON object or null (up to 4096 characters). Model, messages, streaming, tools, token limits and prototype keys cannot be overridden.

thinkingGenericHint.message: Unrecognized model: Automatic uses API defaults. Explicit on/off uses thinking.type = enabled/disabled; customize if your API differs.

thinkingDeepSeekHint.message: DeepSeek: Automatic disables thinking for translation. Enable it to adjust reasoning effort.

thinkingM3Hint.message: MiniMax M3: Automatic disables thinking for translation. Enabling uses adaptive; reasoning effort is not supported.

thinkingFlashHint.message: MiniMax M3.1 Flash Preview always thinks. It cannot be disabled. Effort: low / medium / high / xhigh / max; Automatic uses the API default max.

thinkingCustomHint.message: Custom mapping replaces built-in thinking and effort controls. Automatic sends neither action; API defaults apply.

thinkingCannotEnable.message: This model mapping does not support enabling thinking. Choose Automatic or change the mapping.

thinkingCannotDisable.message: This model cannot disable thinking. Choose Automatic / Enabled, or customize for a gateway with different capabilities.

thinkingEffortUnsupported.message: This reasoning effort is not supported by the selected mapping. Choose Automatic or a supported level.

errModelParametersInvalid.message: The model thinking settings are incompatible. Open settings and correct the thinking mode or API mapping.

minimalServicesHint.message: Choose a model and add your key to start translating.

minimalReadingHint.message: Choose your language and reading style.

minimalSitesHint.message: Set translation preferences for specific websites.

onboardingSimpleHint.message: Choose a service, add your key, and start reading.

contentHelp.message: One CSS selector per line; blank and duplicate lines are removed. Only this exact hostname is edited. Save to use these rules the next time you start translation.

contentEmptyHint.message: An empty custom list collects no content. Restore defaults to inherit.

ignoreEmptyHint.message: An empty custom list removes site exclusions; universal protections remain.

contentProtections.message: Always protected: code, native controls, editable areas, translate=no, notranslate, and TapTranslate elements. Exclusions take precedence over content selectors.

contentCheckHelp.message: Read-only: uses this draft and counts matching elements, not translation units. If Settings is the active tab, checks the most recently visited other tab in this window. No page text is sent or saved.

contentLimitError.message: $1, line $2: invalid rule or limit exceeded. Maximum 200 hosts, 100 lines per field, 2,048 characters per selector, and 256 KiB total.

contentSaveError.message: Could not save: $1. Your draft is retained.

CHECK_HOST_MISMATCH.message: The current webpage hostname does not match the domain being edited. Visit that domain and return to Settings.

CHECK_UNSUPPORTED.message: This page cannot be checked. Use a regular HTTP(S) webpage; browser and extension pages are unsupported.

CHECK_PERMISSION.message: Site access was not granted. Your draft is unchanged.

CHECK_UNAVAILABLE.message: Could not check the webpage. It may have navigated or be unavailable.

workspaceSitesHint.message: Select a site to edit its translation preferences and content rules.

workspaceSaveHint.message: Save all changes. New rules apply the next time translation starts.

backupScope.message: Export and import all saved settings, rules, credentials, valid translation cache and setup state.

backupSavedOnly.message: Exports use saved data. Save or discard pending changes before exporting or importing.

backupUnsaved.message: You have unsaved changes. Save or discard them first.

backupTooLarge.message: The file exceeds the 20 MiB backup limit.

backupRestoreWarning.message: This replaces all saved settings, rules, cache and setup state. Stop translation and close other settings tabs first. Secrets are included. Browser permissions require approval; existing permissions are retained. Refresh webpages after restoring.

backupCounts.message: $1 services · $2 site preferences · $3 custom content rules · $4 built-in profiles · $5 valid cache entries

backupPermissionHint.message: The following host permissions will be requested. Browser-managed API permissions, shortcuts and private-window access cannot be restored automatically.

backupPrivateWarning.message: This JSON contains unencrypted API keys (including session-only keys), HTTP headers and cached translations. Keep it private. Session keys remain session-only after restore. Current webpage state and running tasks are not included.

backupRestored.message: Data imported. Refresh webpages before translating.

gistLead.message: Back up to your GitHub account with encryption. Restore only when you choose.

gistExperimental.message: Preview feature: the maximum 20 MiB upload has not yet been verified against GitHub. File export remains available.

gistCreateToken.message: Create a token with gist permission ↗

gistPasswordHint.message: At least 12 characters. Use the same password to restore on another device. Forgotten passwords cannot be recovered.

gistConsent.message: Saved settings, API keys, headers, website rules and valid translation cache will be encrypted and uploaded to GitHub. Keep your backup password safe.

gistSessionOnly.message: The token and password stay in this settings page only. Reconnect after closing or refreshing it. Connecting does not upload anything.

gistChooseBackup.message: Choose a backup to compare or restore

gistDifferent.message: This device differs from the selected backup

gistSecretDifference.message: Credentials are compared, but their values are never shown here. Cache changes are listed separately.

gistOtherVersion.message: Other backups are available in history. Your selected version has not changed.

gistEncryptedDetails.message: Device and version details appear after decryption.

gistDisconnectHint.message: Clear this page’s credentials and local connection details. Backups on GitHub will remain.

gistPendingHint.message: An upload result is not confirmed. Check it before creating another backup. Continue searching if more pages are available.

gistNewDespitePending.message: A previous upload may have succeeded. This creates another independent backup; the previous one is preserved.

gistUndoHint.message: Restored. Refresh translated webpages. Undo is available only while this settings page stays open.

gistUndoWarning.message: This replaces saved changes made since the restore with the previous snapshot.

gistExpiredCache.message: $1 expired cache entries will not be restored.

gistRollbackDone.message: Restore failed. The previous data was restored.

gistRollbackFailed.message: Restore failed and some previous data could not be restored. Keep your backup and retry after checking browser storage.

gistErrorBUSY.message: Another data operation is running. Try again when it finishes.

gistErrorLOCK_UNAVAILABLE.message: This browser cannot safely coordinate data operations. Update the browser and try again.

gistErrorCHANGED.message: Saved data changed. Close this preview and open it again before restoring.

gistErrorPERMISSION.message: Required permissions were not granted or were revoked. Reconnect to request them. No restore was applied.

gistErrorPRIVATE.message: Gist backup and restore are unavailable in private windows.

gistErrorTOO_LARGE.message: The backup exceeds the supported size. Use file export instead.

gistErrorINVALID.message: The backup or response is incomplete, damaged, or uses an unsupported format.

gistErrorPASSWORD.message: The password does not match, or the backup is damaged. Reconnect with the original password.

gistErrorPASSWORD_LENGTH.message: Use at least 12 characters and no more than 1024 UTF-8 bytes for the password.

gistErrorTOKEN.message: The GitHub token is missing, invalid, or expired. Reconnect with a valid token.

gistErrorFORBIDDEN.message: GitHub refused access. Check that the token has Gists write permission.

gistErrorRATE_LIMITED.message: GitHub limited requests. Retry after the indicated time, if shown.

gistErrorNOT_FOUND.message: The selected backup could not be found. It may have been deleted.

gistErrorNETWORK.message: Could not reach GitHub. Check your connection and retry.

gistErrorREMOTE.message: GitHub rejected the operation. Your previous backups are unchanged.

gistErrorOWNER.message: This Gist does not belong to the connected account.

gistErrorPUBLIC.message: This Gist is public. Choose a Secret Gist backup.

gistErrorPENDING.message: The upload result is still unknown. Check the pending upload or continue searching; it will not be retried automatically.

gistErrorVERIFY.message: The uploaded backup could not be verified. Do not treat it as a successful backup yet.

gistErrorUNKNOWN.message: The data operation failed. Check the backup format, browser permissions and available storage before retrying.
